text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, could you please tell me your age and whether you have ever had a period? Also, have you experienced any unexplained fractures or frequent falls in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of virilization at birth, acne, and bone fragility, I need to rule out a metabolic bone disorder or an enzyme deficiency. REQUEST TEST: Serum_calcium_phosphorus_ALP_testosterone_17_OH_progen

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal bone mineral markers and the history of congenital virilization, I suspect a disorder of steroidogenesis. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone_level

speaker: Doctor
text: The markedly elevated 17-hydroxyprogesterone level confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: 21-hydroxylase deficiency (Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia)
